Include any interesting details about the hobby that would make your friend curious to learn more.
Hey buddy! Just wanted to give you a shout and tell you about a new hobby I've been getting into lately – calligraphy! I've always been fascinated by the beauty and elegance of handwritten letters, but never had the time to explore it until recently. I started by taking an online course on YouTube, and now I'm hooked! Every Sunday afternoon, I sit down with my calligraphy kit and create these beautiful quotes and designs that I frame and display around my home. It's such a relaxing and fulfilling activity, and the sense of accomplishment I get from completing a piece is amazing. Plus, there's something so magical about the way the ink flows across the page and the way the letters take shape. I even started practicing my calligraphy skills by creating custom wedding invitations for my friends
